reviews.title: Close AS3 Areas 2, 4 and 5 object_proxy, Function, BlendMode.SHADER, mask, and SWF Loader gaps
reviews.summary: Implements flash.utils.object_proxy and Proxy/ObjectProxy meta-trap dispatch, full Function call/apply/new Function/prototype/arguments.caller semantics, 2-input Pixel Bender BlendMode.SHADER compositing, dynamic/nested/TextField/Video/Bitmap DisplayObject.mask clipping and hit-testing, and pure-Rust FWS/CWS/ZWS SWF AVM1/AVM2 execution in Loader.load and loadBytes.

entries.note: Supports flash.utils.object_proxy and mx.utils.object_proxy namespace imports, use namespace object_proxy, flash.utils.Proxy meta-trap subclassing (getProperty, setProperty, callProperty, hasProperty, deleteProperty, nextNameIndex/nextName/nextValue, isAttribute), and mx.utils.ObjectProxy PropertyChangeEvent dispatch.

Supports Function declarations, expressions, closures, bound class methods, Function.prototype.call/apply with primitive receiver boxing, arity length, writable prototype and new Ctor(...) construction, dynamic new Function(...params, body) compilation, and AS3 arguments.caller === undefined.

Evaluates 2-input Pixel Bender blendShader kernels (dst background + src foreground RGBA) across Rust evaluate_blend_shader_rgba, PixelArena::draw_rgba, BitmapData.draw, and HTML5 Stage DisplayObject compositing when blendMode == BlendMode.SHADER.

Clips Stage rendering, BitmapData.draw (including external mask sources), and shape-flag hitTestPoint across dynamic mask assignment/reassignment/nulling, nested mask chains, geometric paths, soft alpha/PNG/Bitmap masks, and TextField/Video mask sources while keeping getBounds/getRect unmasked.

Loads images (PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP), NeoFlash HTML5 child bundles, and raw FWS/CWS/ZWS SWF movies (decoding timelines, shapes, sprites, bitmaps, text, and AVM1/AVM2 bytecode into a live MovieClip with contentLoaderInfo events and unloadAndStop cleanup) within browser CORS/origin limits.

Decodes in-memory PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP ByteArrays and raw FWS/CWS/ZWS SWF ByteArrays into live Bitmap or multi-frame AVM1/AVM2 MovieClip content with contentLoaderInfo metadata, frame navigation, and unloadAndStop cleanup.
